needs_atom.missing: An ownership filter predicate: 'At the beginning of your end step, if you control three or more permanents you don't own, draw three cards.' The condition is CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 3 over 'permanents you don't own', which needs an FAtomPred testing the object's OWNER (e.g. OWNER_IS who=YOU, negated); FAtomPred has CONTROLLER_IS only, and a control-only count would fire on your own permanents (stronger than printed). Mappable: the ETB 'gain control of target permanent' (GAIN_CONTROL, no duration) and the end-step trigger/draw-3 shape.
